M25-0073-P3 — Counterevidence: Uses on connected Sigma or local individual singularity do not show core failure.

proposition.claim:
A Ckalpha upper bound, area/index bounds and exclusion of higher multiplicities give compactness.

Unique ambient double cover with connected two-sided lift.

First Dirichlet eigenspace simple for arbitrary UcapSigma.

The set of f for which Lu=nu(f) has no slower-growth invariant solution contains open dense subset, without requiring singularities.
